1.title: Congressional Oversight Commission
1.description:
Official YouTube channel of the Congressional Oversight Commission, established by Section 4020 of Title IV, Subtitle A of the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security Act (CARES Act), (P.L. 116-136).  

The members of the Commission are Rep. French Hill (R-AR), Commissioner Donna E. Shalala (D-FL) and Sen. Pat Toomey (R-PA).

1.title: Congressional Oversight Commission Hearing (Loans for Businesses Critical to National Security)
1.description: The purpose of the hearing is to examine the funds authorized by the CARES Act that provide up to $17 billion for loans and loan guarantees to businesses critical to maintaining national security.
